messages.author: 022b3a4e8303f469
messages.subject: Missing part of the visual summary
parts:
Hi All,
I found a certain day missing from the visual summary but good in the night .csv summary. 
I used SPT to detect the sleep period time window, excludefirstlast = FALSE,   includenightcrit = 16. Did anyone have the same issue? Could you please give me some advice? I am attaching two examples. Thank you so much! 
Best,
Xinting Yu

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Missing part of the visual summary
parts:
Thanks for reporting. It is a bit difficult for me to investigate this quickly now. My guess is that this is a problem specific to the visualisation function and not related to the rest of GGIR.

However, if you could share the corresponding .RData file from the meta/basic folder and an R script to help reproduce the problem then that would allow me or others to have a closer look. 

Thanks,
Vincent
